description: Weekly volume + Recovery cards in the Gym tab of index.html: logged/planned effective sets per muscle per ISO week, rules, readiness indicator, ES translations, and tools/gym-volume.test.mjs. REUSE muscleOf/MMAP/MRX/MUSG/MUSL, gMuscleSets conventions, gdl/gdlon, gses/gstat, rcv. Do not duplicate them. Do not change MBAND or the plan-config 'Weekly sets per muscle' card behaviour (rear delts added to row mappings may add a row there, acceptable).
steps: MAPPING (index.html near MMAP/MRX/muscleOf ~line 3224-3286): (a) add ES-name keyword list MRX_ES tried FIRST inside muscleOf (so 'curl femoral' is hamstrings not biceps): remo->upper back(+lats,biceps,rear delts); jalon/dominada->lats(+biceps); curl femoral/isquio/femoral->hamstrings; extension de cuadriceps/extension de pierna->quads; sentadilla/prensa de pierna->quads(+glutes); peso muerto rumano->hamstrings(+glutes); empuje de cadera->glutes(+hamstrings); gemelo/pantorrilla->calves; elevacion(es) lateral(es)->side delts; pajaros/deltoide posterior->rear delts; triceps/fondos/press frances->triceps; curl/biceps->biceps; abdominal/plancha->abs; press banca/press inclinado/aperturas->chest(+triceps,front delts). Make regexes accent-insensitive (normalize NFD and strip diacritics before testing, or include both forms). (b) add EN fallbacks to MRX: overhead/shoulder/military press -> front delts primary, secondary side delts + triceps (put BEFORE the bench/chest-press rule); generic /press/ as last chest fallback (after leg press/squat rules); keep leg curl before curl. (c) add 'rear delts' as secondary for ROW entries in MMAP and the /row/ MRX rule (rows give rear delts 0.5; NOT pulldowns). (d) override: S.gym.musc[name]=<MUSG key>; add pure helper gvMus(name,ov) = override primary with secondaries [] if ov[name] is a valid MUSG key, else muscleOf(name). Ensure S.gym.musc is created lazily and that backup/import already carries S.gym wholesale (check).

CONSTANTS (single const GV near gMuscleState): band [10,14], sessMax 7, exMax 2, effRir 4 (RIR>=5 junk), myoPrimary 3, myoSecondary 1.5, secWeight 0.5, coverMin 6 (indirect sets that make front/rear delts 'Covered indirectly' when direct==0), red threshold for 'above' (e.g. >18 -> red class else amber). Document each in a comment. Display groups: chest, back (lats+upper back merged), side delts, front delts, rear delts, biceps, triceps | quads, hamstrings, glutes, calves, abs. Upper list vs Lower list. Adductors: not modelled (say so in findings).

PURE FUNCTIONS (all one-line-style functions like the rest of the file, no S access inside, take ctx args so they are testable): gvMon(dateStr)->Monday YYYY-MM-DD (local date math, Monday start); gvCredit(name,kind,myo,sets,ov)->[{m,w,dir}] (non-myo: primary sets*1, secondaries sets*0.5 only if kind H; myo: fixed 3 primary / 1.5 each secondary regardless of mini-set count; merge lats/upper back into 'back' only at display time via gvGrp); gvSets(rows)->effective count: working sets with rir<=GV.effRir, rir null/undefined/'' counts as effective (documented), warm-ups never passed in; gvLog(wl,week,ctx{ov,mx,kindOf})->per-session and weekly aggregate for logged sessions whose gvMon(w.d)==week: use w.sn.items[].e.k for compound kind (fallback gkind(name)), myo detected when w.prime[name] exists or ctx.mx[name]=='myo' (myo credit applies if prime present or >=1 effective mini-set), warm ignored, deload sessions (w.dl) counted normally; gvPlan(items)->planned weekly from live routine using e.s authored sets (not gsets) and gMethod==myo, built from gPlan()/gday(i) the same way gMuscleSets does; result shape {byMus:{grp:{sets,dir,ind,ex:[{n,dir,ind}],}}, sessions:[{t,byMus}]}; gvStatus(grp,sets,dir,ind)->{k:'low|ok|high|red|cover|none', cls} (front/rear delts with dir==0 and ind>=coverMin => 'cover' green; muscles with 0 planned and 0 done => 'none'); gvFlags(sessions)->[{t,grp,type:'sets'|'ex',v}] for sets>7 (direct+indirect weighted, merged group) and direct exercises>2; gvRatio(totals)->{bi:bool,tri:bool} biceps total > back total, triceps total > chest+front+side+rear delts totals; gvReady(inp{sl:[hours],sr:[1..5],mo:[1..5],dec,stall,dl,dleDays})->{k:'ok|watch|deload|none|dl', pts, why:[strings]}: sleep avg of >=3 logged days in last 7: <7 =>1pt, <6.5 =>2pt ('Sleep averaged X h'); stress avg of >=2 days: >=3 =>1pt, >=3.5 =>2pt ('Stress averaged X out of 5'); mood >=3 logged days, low=mood<=2: low>=2 =>1pt, low/logged>=0.5 =>2pt ('Mood low N of M days'); performance: dec>=2 =>2pt, dec==1 or stall>=2 =>1pt ('N lifts dropping' / 'N lifts stalling'); total 0 ok, 1-2 watch, >=3 deload; no data at all => none; active deload => dl; deload ended within the last 7 days downgrades 'deload' to 'watch'. Document thresholds in comment.

WRAPPERS reading S (thin): gvPerf() using gses()/gstat() with galert's 28-day recency, counting dec and stall lifts; gvInputs() collecting last 7 calendar days of S.slp, S.str, S.journal moods (use fmt()/today()); gvWeekState(off) -> data for the viewed week (week navigator var gvOff, 0 = this week, negative = past, no future beyond this week). Planned numbers always come from the live routine.

UI: new function gvolCard() and grecCard(). Insert `${gvolCard()}${grecCard()}` in the gym view template right after the closing of the '📊 Gym stats' card (line ~3832, before the '<div class="note">' with the calendar of tools). 'Weekly volume' card: week navigator row (‹ This week / week of Mon DD ›, uses actions gvw with data-v -1/1/0), subtitle line with the 10-14 target, two sub-headings Upper and Lower, one row per muscle: label, horizontal bar (reuse .bar/.bar i styles; add small new CSS only if needed, using var(--olv-t) green; shaded target band 10-14 as an absolutely positioned child like .bar.tg .tk; bar scale to max(16, max value)); colored by status via classes (ok green, low/high amber with --gold, red uses --warn-fg), numeric 'done / planned' label, and a status pill (.hst .ok/.w) text: 'Below target','On target','Above target, recovery cost','Covered indirectly'. For past weeks show done only plus planned for reference. Tapping a row (data-a=gvm data-m=grp) toggles an inline detail listing contributing exercises with 'Direct' and 'Indirect' amounts and a small '✎ Muscle' button (data-a=gvmu data-n=name) that expands a chip row of the 13 MUSG groups plus 'Auto' to set/clear S.gym.musc[name] then save(). Under the rows: warnings list (.note.al low style or small .hst.w lines): 'More than 7 sets for {muscle} in one session' (also 'More than 2 exercises for {muscle} in one session'), 'Biceps exceed back', 'Triceps exceed chest and shoulders'. Mobile-first compact, no horizontal overflow at 360px. 'Recovery' card: status headline with .hst pill ('Recovery OK' / 'Watch recovery' / 'Consider a deload week' / 'Not enough data yet' / 'Deload week in progress'), reasons list, and when k=='deload' a button data-a=gdlon labelled 'Start deload' (existing handler; no new deload mechanism); explanatory one-liner of what is measured. No toast, no popup.

EVENT HANDLERS: add actions gvw, gvm, gvmu, gvmp (pick) in the click dispatcher near gwcp (line ~4860) following how neighbours call render; reset gvOff sensibly; ensure save() is called after override.

ES: add every new string to the ES dictionary (key = exact EN string) and use R regexes for strings with numbers/muscle names. Required: Weekly volume=Volumen semanal, Effective sets=Series efectivas, Planned=Planeadas, Done=Hechas, Below target=Por debajo del objetivo, On target=En el objetivo, Above target, recovery cost=Por encima del objetivo, coste de recuperación, Chest=Pecho, Back=Espalda, Lateral delts=Hombro lateral, Front delts=Hombro frontal, Rear delts=Hombro posterior, Biceps=Bíceps, Triceps=Tríceps, Quads=Cuádriceps, Hamstrings=Isquios, Glutes=Glúteos, Calves=Gemelos, Abs=Abdomen, Lats=Dorsales, Upper back=Espalda alta, Upper, Lower=Superior, Inferior, Direct=Directas, Indirect=Indirectas, Covered indirectly=Cubierto indirectamente, Recovery=Recuperación, Recovery OK=Recuperación bien, Watch recovery=Vigila tu recuperación, Consider a deload week=Considera una semana de descarga, Start deload=Empezar descarga, 'More than 7 sets for {muscle} in one session'=>'Más de 7 series para {músculo} en una sesión', 'More than 2 exercises for {muscle} in one session', 'Biceps exceed back'=>'El bíceps supera a la espalda', 'Triceps exceed chest and shoulders'=>'El tríceps supera a pecho y hombro', reasons ('Sleep averaged X h','Stress averaged X out of 5','Mood low N of M days','N lifts dropping','N lifts stalling'), week labels, empty states, 'Auto', '✎ Muscle'. Muscle names inside dynamic sentences must be translated with the ES label (ES label of 'side delts' for the display is 'Hombro lateral', etc.).

TESTS: create tools/gym-volume.test.mjs extracting the REAL functions/consts from index.html (extend the approach of tools/fin-extract.mjs: fn(name) and konst(name); MMAP/MRX/GPOOL are multi-line consts so extract them by balanced bracket scanning, or evaluate from 'const MMAP={' up to the matching '};'). Cover: mapping (exact name, keyword fallback EN, ES names incl 'Curl femoral' not biceps, 'Remo', 'Elevaciones laterales', user override); effective-set counting (RIR 4 counts, RIR 5 excluded, null RIR counts, warm-ups excluded, myo = 3 / 1.5 fixed regardless of mini-set count, secondary 0.5 only for compounds); ISO week bucketing (Sunday belongs to the previous Monday, month/year boundary); snapshot use (routine changed after logging, snapshot kind/names still used); planned sets from routine (compare with gMuscleSets totals for a sample routine so both agree); band status incl cover rule; per-session >7 and >2 exercises flags; biceps<=back and triceps<=chest+shoulders; readiness scoring with sleep/stress/mood/stall inputs, thresholds boundaries, no-data case, active deload, post-deload downgrade. Tests must fail if the real code is reverted.
acceptance_criteria: node tools/gym-volume.test.mjs passes and exercises the real functions extracted from index.html
All existing tools/*.test.mjs still pass and chk.sh prints syntax ok
Gym tab HTML contains 'Weekly volume' and 'Recovery' cards after 'Gym stats' with the sample state and no literal 'undefined' or 'NaN'
Existing deload mechanism (gdlon) is the only way a deload starts
Every new user-visible string has an ES translation (rendered with LANG es shows no untranslated new English)
verification: for f in tools/*.test.mjs; do node $f || exit 1; done
findings: Implemented in index.html only (gymapp.html, sw.js untouched; nothing committed). New tools/gym-volume.test.mjs (22 tests) extracts REAL code via fn/konst/block scanning. chk.sh syntax ok, all tools/*.test.mjs pass. Harness: /projects/sandbox/_h/gv.mjs + gvr.mjs render both cards EN and ES on forma-backup-3dias.json (weeks 0,-1,-2 and full gviewImpl): no 'undefined'/'NaN'. MAPPING: MRX_ES (Spanish keywords, tested first on NFD-stripped lowercase name via gvNorm) in muscleOf after exact MMAP; EN MRX: (overhead|shoulder|military|arnold) press -> front delts (+side delts, triceps) before bench rule, generic /press/ chest fallback last, pressdown added to triceps; rows (MMAP rows + /row/) add rear delts as secondary (0.5 for compounds). gvMus(name,ov) override = S.gym.musc[name] -> only direct target. CONSTANTS GV: band [10,14], sessMax 7, exMax 2, effRir 4, myoPrimary 3, myoSecondary 1.5, secWeight .5, coverMin 6, red 18. Status: <10 low (amber), 10-14 ok, 14-18 high (amber), >18 red (new .hst.r), front/rear delts with 0 direct and >=6 indirect = 'Covered indirectly' (green), 0 sets = none. Display groups upper: chest, back (lats+upper back), side/front/rear delts, biceps, triceps; lower: quads, hamstrings, glutes, calves, abs. Adductors not modelled. CONVENTIONS: blank/null RIR counts as effective; RIR<=4 counts; warm-ups ignored; deload sessions counted normally; myo credit if prime present or >=1 effective mini-set; kind from snapshot sn.items[].e.k else gkind; a secondary credit landing in the same display group as the lift's direct credit is dropped (rows: lats 0.5 not added on top of upper back), so back = gMuscleSets lats+upper back minus that 0.5 per row set (test asserts it); all other muscles equal gMuscleSets. Week starts Monday via gvMon. Past weeks: status from done; this week: status from planned routine (live, authored e.s) when planned>0 else done; bar fill = done, gold tick = planned, shaded band 10-14. Flags (>7 sets, >2 direct exercises) from logged sessions plus, for this week, planned sessions; ratio rules on the basis totals. READINESS gvReady: sleep avg (>=3 days of last 7) <7h 1pt, <6.5h 2pt; stress avg (>=2 days) >=3 1pt, >=3.5 2pt; mood (>=3 days, low<=2) low>=2 1pt, low/logged>=0.5 2pt; lifts dropping (gstat dec>=2, 28 day recency like galert) >=2 2pt, 1 dropping or >=2 stalling (since>=3) 1pt; 0 ok, 1-2 watch, >=3 deload; none if no sleep/stress/mood threshold data and no dropping/stalling lifts; deload active = 'dl'; deload ended <=7 days ago downgrades deload to watch (adds reason 'You finished a deload in the last 7 days'). Start deload button reuses data-a=gdlon. UI: gvolCard()/grecCard() inserted after Gym stats card; actions gvw/gvm/gvmu/gvmp added to dispatcher and to the gview-refresh list (scroll preserved, no full re-render); state vars gvOff/gvOpen/gvPick. CSS block added after .hst.ok. DEVIATIONS: (1) existing dictionary maps 'Back' to 'Atras' (navigation) and 'Chest','Glutes','Calves' already exist, so muscle labels are chosen in code by LANG (GVL table, same approach as gMuscleSummary esLabel) instead of dictionary; sentence regexes (R) translate the muscle via gvEs. New dictionary block DX3 (only fills undefined keys) holds the other strings; 'Done'/'Planned' are not used as bare labels (existing 'Done'='Listo'), captions use 'Effective sets done / planned...' regexes. (2) S.gym.musc is created lazily on first override; backup/import carry S.gym wholesale (bkExport stringifies S). (3) Rear delts now appear in the plan-config 'Weekly sets per muscle' card via row secondaries, and shoulder presses now map to front delts there (MBAND unchanged).
